weather_report:
Evening has settled over Sydney under an unbroken quilt of cloud. The light is pewter and diffuse, with no sunshine to chase; UV is effectively absent now and into the night. Edges are softened, colors tuned down a step, the horizon a quiet smudge while the air feels steady and calm rather than sparkling.

Expect a cool, subdued night. A light jacket or sweater will feel right, perhaps a scarf if you run cold; no need for sun gear, and an umbrella only if you like to be prepared. It’s a good time for modest errands, a gentle loop of the neighborhood before dinner, a train ride to meet a friend, or settling in to straighten the desk and let a pot simmer while the city hums beyond the glass. If you head out later, think comfortable layers you can keep on without fuss; the sky isn’t offering breaks, just a patient, even grey.
